name: Study
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of diligent study and meditation on God's Word as a path to wisdom and success. Joshua 1:8 encourages continual reflection on the law to live rightly and prosper, while Proverbs highlights that true knowledge begins with the fear of the LORD and that the wise actively seek and increase in learning through instruction. Ecclesiastes adds that a discerning heart earnestly searches for wisdom and understanding, recognizing the folly of ignorance. Together, these verses teach that study is a disciplined pursuit of divine truth, leading to spiritual growth and godly wisdom.
